title: Modding/Combining two games together, how are they doing it?
author: No-Tie-5552
selftext: I saw an instagram but I didn't save it I wish I did, where someone put Super Mario 64 into Halo for example and there were numerous other examples of having physics of one game into another and not just a character swap. How are people able to achieve this? They're outputting these mods so incredibly fast

comments.author: Grand_Sprinkles_2094
comments.body: Fascinating world we live in isn’t it? Well there is a GitHub repo called [https://github.com/rehan-remade/universal-modder](https://github.com/rehan-remade/universal-modder) you use it with Claude code opus 5.5 and tell it to merge both games. Something like pass through method where you run both games and overlay one game on top of another, or you just copy another game’s mechanics. Just play with it, you’ll have a lot of fun. I’m still thinking of combining some games.
